facts.text: NavigationEnv subclasses Isaac Lab's ManagerBasedRLEnv and creates an ObservationDelayManager before the other managers are loaded
Isaac-Nav-MDPO-AoW-D-v0 is registered with entry point isaaclab_nav_task.navigation:NavigationEnv and the AowDNavigationEnvCfg configuration
The task is hierarchical: a high-level policy emits SE2 velocity commands (vx, vy, omega) at 5 Hz and a pre-trained low-level locomotion policy converts them to joint actions at 50 Hz
The action term has action_dim 3 for [vx, vy, omega]
The configured action path uses use_raw_actions=True, policy_scaling [1.5, 1.0, 1.0] and policy_distr_type 'gaussian'
With use_raw_actions=True the raw action is kept; gaussian processing applies tanh, adds the observed speed norm times policy_bias, then multiplies by policy_scaling
The environment sets sim.dt = 0.005 s, decimation = int((1 / sim.dt) / PLANNING_FREQ), episode_length_s = 60.0 s and is_finite_horizon = True
The robot goal command is resampled only on episode reset: resampling_time_range is (1e9, 1e9)
The reset event samples the base yaw uniformly from (-pi, pi) and randomizes joint positions by scale 0.5 to 1.5
The termination terms are time_out, base_contact (threshold 1.0), large_pitch_angle (threshold 40), early_termination at_goal (distance_threshold 0.5) and terrain_fall (fall_height_threshold -2.0)
time_out_navigation increments time_at_goal whenever the XY goal distance is below distance_threshold
at_goal_navigation counts the current goal entry or any earlier entry with time_at_goal > 0, and terminates when the counter exceeds required_time_at_goal_in_steps
The observation groups are metrics, policy, critic and low_level_policy
The raycast camera is downsampled from 192x120 to 64x40 and has max_distance 11.0
The simulator prerequisites are Isaac Lab v2.1.1, Isaac Sim 4.5.0, Python 3.10 and PyTorch >= 2.5.1
The repository excludes the rsl_rl learning module and the PPO/MDPO training algorithms
The two robot platforms are B2W (bipedal wheeled) and AoW-D (Anymal on Wheels)

determinism.notes: the analytic fake draws its reset yaw and goal from Python's random.Random(seed) and its kinematics are deterministic, so a seed and an action sequence repeat a trajectory of this fake; the upstream Isaac Sim environment's random number stream and physics are not reproduced

gaps: absence of dynamics: this is an F0 analytic stand-in with no rigid-body physics, contacts, friction, actuators, locomotion policy, depth raycasting, observation delay or domain randomization; none of the Isaac Sim behaviour of the upstream task is modelled, including the base_contact, large_pitch_angle and terrain_fall terminations

the action bounds [-1, 1] and every observation size are the fake's placeholders: the real action and observation spaces are built by the external Isaac Lab ManagerBasedRLEnv and are not defined in the clone; only the 3-dimensional [vx, vy, omega] action layout and the four observation group names are sourced (navigation_se2_actions.py:42 and navigation_env_cfg.py:247-251)

the observation groups are reduced stand-ins: the upstream policy and critic groups include a delayed depth image from the 64x40 raycast camera (navigation_env_cfg.py:85-105) and a height scan, and the low-level group includes joint positions and velocities; this fake returns 10, 12, 10 and 1 values per group and omits those terms, as recorded in RESULT.json notes

the goal, reset pose and reward are stand-ins: upstream samples goals from terrain masks on reset (navigation_env_cfg.py:137-142), randomizes yaw and joints (navigation_env_cfg.py:271-283) and computes the reward from Isaac Lab physics terms (navigation_env_cfg.py:338-367); no trajectory or reward of this fake was compared with an upstream run

no captured traffic or transcript is shipped in the clone, so this analytic fake is used instead of a recording; it was never compared with the upstream environment: Isaac Lab v2.1.1 and Isaac Sim 4.5 are not installed where the gate runs, and no sim backend was declared because a live backend would import and run the upstream task

only the fake backend is declared: the inherited generic gymnasium.make fallback is not a supported live adapter. The shipped train.py parses argv, launches AppLauncher, registers tasks and supplies cfg before gym.make (scripts/train.py:35-60, :67-103); those application lifecycle and vectorized torch action/observation requirements are not implemented by this single-environment analytic contract

the upstream goal counter keeps advancing after the first radius entry even after leaving the goal (terminations.py:62-65, :158-166); it is not a requirement to remain inside the radius for four seconds
the fake uses the zero default policy_bias; it omits the upstream speed-dependent bias, low-pass filter and low-level policy path (navigation_se2_actions.py:176-182, :240)
snapshot and restore are not offered: this fake exposes no get_state or set_state methods

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the declared analytic fake stops advancing and keeps its state readable; no step or world reset is accepted while latched. mhs.safety.reset releases only the latch and advances no ticks. No pause or stop of an external Isaac Sim application is provided
